metadata.blurb: Phantom is a user-friendly Ethereum and Solana wallet. It focuses on ease of use, easy swapping of tokens and NFTs, and integration with popular DeFi and NFT exchange protocols within the wallet.

ref.explanation: Phantom describes a wallet as a top-level container created using a Secret Recovery Phrase or Google/Apple account plus PIN.
Phantom says users can send from a newly created or imported wallet and exposes addresses across supported chains.
Phantom's send-token help says users can send to domain names such as solana.sol or vault.eth, which resolve automatically to valid addresses on supported networks.
Phantom says its Crosschain Swapper lets users bridge tokens across Solana, Ethereum, Base, and Polygon inside Phantom.
Phantom's bridge explainer describes in-wallet bridging through the built-in Crosschain Swapper.
Phantom describes itself as a multi-chain wallet where users can manage assets across Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Bitcoin, Base, Sui, and Monad without switching wallets.
